more_info.overview: Silver colour consists of metallic silver in powder or small-sheet form, used to impart a silver appearance to permitted foods. It is used to add colour or restore colour lost during food manufacture. The material is supplied as silver-coloured powder or small sheets. EU permissions include other confectionery including breath freshening micro-sweets.
more_info.uses:
Examples in the EU food-use list include certain other confectionery including breath freshening microsweets; decorations, coatings and fillings, except fruit-based fillings covered by category 4.2.4; spirit drinks as defined in Regulation 2019/787.
The entries apply to particular food categories and may limit the amount, the preparation or the way it is used; they do not show how often the additive appears in retail products.
more_info.side_effects:
EFSA could not assess food-use safety in 2016 because the tested materials and food additive were insufficiently characterised.
Silver-ion release and particle size were unresolved issues; this does not establish harm at a particular food dose.
